title: strateuma militaris
intro: Strateuma militaris, commonly known as the Devil's Claw, is a flowering plant native to southern Africa that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory properties, which help alleviate pain and swelling associated with arthritis, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and reduce nausea. The therapeutic actions of Devil's Claw include its analgesic and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help relieve muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Devil's Claw include iridoid glycosides, particularly harpagoside, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
